data.leadership_messages: 1. The IIR#2 Execution Review was conducted on 15 July 2026. On 16 July, the team identified a critical gap in the required task documentation. Although a continuous search and retrieval effort was maintained from 17 July through 3 August, ongoing document updates by external stakeholders made assessing these shifting requirements highly challenging.2. CA includes 15 child tasks. 3. Based on the WBS descriptions of the child tasks, we are unable to ascertain whether any of the originally provided CA data provided by NG on 4/16/26 is integrated into this CA. Based on discussions with NG on 8/4/26, the data previously tracked by the SPO from April ’26 has either been deleted, reassigned, redistributed, or rolled into other WBS elements due to duplicability. For awareness, we have listed those CAs below:
data.rationale: Data sets constantly changing from day-to-day making it difficult to understand long-term scope impacts. The team can only conduct analysis based on the most current data. Would meet the requirements of IIR#2. Beyond that will be more challenging.

areas.text: This WBS element provides the ongoing, non‑discrete effort required to plan, monitor, and control the Launch Ex PM LOE control account throughout IFC 1.0 and INC 1. It supplies the management infrastructure, reporting, and governance needed for earned‑value tracking of the hardware‑related I&T work packages.This WBS element is also for the Integration, Assembly, Test, & Checkout activities that are necessary to ensure that requirements and design, at the Product level, are properly assessed and verified. Lab development and product assembly/checkout for individual pieces of hardware is included here. This includes any run-for-record, hardware tests and the associated CDRL development.The work scope of this account includes the resources necessary to manage, direct, support, and control all efforts contributing to the development, production of custom and commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) procurements and integration. Program/Project control and planning activities include developing and maintaining the staffing, budget, and performance metrics.
NG is working toward integration into Prima-vera 6. Final determination can be assessed once full integration is completed. Until that point, the SPO must use currently available resources.
Product element applies solely to KDC elements.
